quests.name: Pack Law
quests.desc: What pack law says about the stronger taking. That she has never lost. That the rule has always been clear and the clarity has always been enough.

quests.name: Fast Enough
quests.pre: She moves fast. He keeps up.
quests.scene: She tests the pace. He matches it. She accelerates. He is still there. She lets him run first — briefly — then takes it back.
quests.post: She lets him run first again the next day. Briefly.

quests.name: The Sister She Follows
quests.desc: Her elder sister Varga specifically. What she learned that was not from Varga. That some knowledge is yours alone.

quests.name: Who Wins This
quests.pre: Pack law is clear about contests.
quests.scene: Contest. She wins the first two. In the third — MASOCHIST lean emerges — she finds out what losing on purpose feels like, once, to test it.
quests.post: 'Interesting.'

quests.name: The Territory She Would Offer
quests.desc: She describes the one place she would bring someone. She has never brought anyone. She describes why not.

quests.name: Tamed Willingly
quests.pre: Pack law says tamed is beneath her.
quests.scene: She presents territory — herself — as a willing offering. PRIMAL TAMING with full consent. She initiates. She is the one who says: 'You can take this.'
quests.post: 'I chose it.' She sounds satisfied. 'That is different from losing.'

quests.name: Territory and Pack
quests.pre: She is thinking about what this makes him.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — DOMINANT/MASOCHIST switching, SADIST reciprocal. She brings him into her territory. Willingly. As she wanted.
quests.post: She marks him. Lightly. 'Pack rule.' She is serious.

quests.name: Chosen, Not Taken
quests.pre: Pack law would say he took it.
quests.scene: 'I chose it. The law does not have a word for that.' She finds this clarifying rather than troubling.
quests.post: She runs next to him. Not ahead.

quests.name: The Broker Who Loses the Brief
quests.pre: She has had every information exchange choreographed.
quests.scene: He asks the right question — not about what she knows, about her. The one she was not ready for. She answers.
quests.post: She resells the answer to no one. First time.

quests.name: Watched While Watching
quests.pre: She watches everyone.
quests.scene: He watches her watching. He describes what she looks like when she watches. He is accurate. She is being seen accurately while seeing.
quests.post: 'You could have used that.' He says: 'I know.' She is quiet for a moment.

quests.name: Nothing to Gain
quests.pre: She has been calculating. The calculation will not close.
quests.scene: She has chosen him when there is nothing to gain. EXHIBITIONIST fully active — she shows him the real inventory: everything, without professional distance. VOYEUR inverted — she is the display.
quests.post: 'I was not going to do that.'

quests.name: The Map She Keeps
quests.pre: She has been keeping a map of where his value lies. Professionally.
quests.scene: She gives him the map. Not the Conclave map — the personal one.
quests.post: 'I retired from brokering that.'

characters.name: Rina Brightbrush
characters.access: Kiri FALLEN + Conclave dismantled world trigger

quests.name: The First Deal's Absolution
quests.pre: She has been carrying the original Conclave mistake for years.
quests.scene: He tells her what happened to the Conclave. She sits with it.
quests.post: 'I can stop counting it.'

quests.name: What Forgiveness Looks Like
quests.pre: First honest conversation she has had that is not about the mistake.
quests.scene: VANILLA/SERVICE — she gives simply, without the guilt underneath the giving.
quests.post: 'I forgot I could do that.'

quests.name: The Dream She Translated
quests.desc: The first Wyrm dream, years ago. What she thought it was. What she knows it is. That Kessa hears it longer than she does.

quests.name: Patience Recognised
quests.pre: She moves in long time.
quests.scene: He waits. He matches her pace exactly — not performance, actual pace.
quests.post: She speaks more in the next hour than she has in a week.

quests.name: Kessa Before the Dreams
quests.desc: Kessa at five, at fifteen. What she is watching for. What she hopes Kessa never has to carry.

quests.name: Long Time Together
quests.pre: She has been finding reasons to be in the same place.
quests.scene: VANILLA/SERVICE — she gives with ancient patience. He receives at her pace.
quests.post: 'You are the first person I have not had to slow down for.'

quests.name: What the Wyrm Knows
quests.pre: She has one piece of Wyrm wisdom she has not shared.
quests.scene: She shares it. It is about this. Extended intimacy — SUBMISSIVE/DEVOTION at depth. VANILLA frame. She gives completely.
quests.post: 'The Wyrm says some things only happen once every thousand years.' It is unclear if she means the Wyrm or herself.

quests.name: In Long Time
quests.pre: She has been thinking in long time about this.
quests.scene: 'In long time, this is the part I will remember.'
quests.post: She marks the date in the old calendar format.

characters.name: Kessa Emberscale
characters.access: Ashkora FALLEN + separate player trust with Kessa

quests.name: Being Certain
quests.pre: She is always unsure.
quests.scene: He gives her something to be certain about.
quests.post: 'That is what that feels like.'

quests.name: Not Afraid
quests.pre: She has questions.
quests.scene: Extended vanilla. She asks questions. He answers all of them.
quests.post: 'I am not afraid of this.' She sounds surprised.

quests.name: The Fabricated Contract
quests.desc: What the fabricated contract cost her. That it was worse than actual violence because it had legal language. What she decided the day she read it.

quests.name: Not Your Leverage
quests.pre: She has been assessing: what does he want from her?
quests.scene: He wants something from her that is not leverage or information. She runs this through three verification passes.
quests.post: She adjusts the assessment. Still watching.

quests.name: Sera Inside
quests.desc: What it is like to know Sera is in there and to act professionally about it every day. What she says to herself each morning.

quests.name: Honest Combat
quests.pre: She fights everything.
quests.scene: They spar. She wins the first round. In the second: REVERSAL CAPTURE — he let her win. She is furious. He waits.
quests.post: 'You let me win the first round.' He says: 'I wanted to see how you fight when you think you are ahead.' She is quiet for a long time.

quests.name: What She Would Have Been
quests.desc: If she had not been assigned to the Sarvoth, if there was no Morvane, if Sera had not needed protecting. She describes it briefly and specifically. She sounds fine.

quests.name: Chosen For Herself
quests.pre: She has been verifying: is it her he wants.
quests.scene: MASOCHIST/DEVOTION — she gives and receives in a way that tests whether she is the subject. She is the subject. She has never been the subject before.
quests.post: 'There is nothing transactional about this.' She checks again. 'No.'

quests.name: The SWITCH Fully Active
quests.pre: She has SADIST and MASOCHIST both.
quests.scene: SWITCH arc — she leads first, he reverses, she accepts. Extended. DEVOTION as the undercurrent.
quests.post: 'I chose both directions.'

quests.name: What the Contract Did Not Take
quests.pre: The contract took three years.
quests.scene: What the contract could not take — she gives it.
quests.post: 'That was mine to give.' Pause. 'I gave it.'

quests.name: Sera and After
quests.pre: When Sera is free, Velara is free. What comes next.
quests.scene: She tells him what comes next. It includes him.
quests.post: She files something in the Charter. Not a contract. A record.

characters.name: Sera Ash
characters.access: Velara FALLEN + Sera freed from Morvane

quests.name: The Door That Locks
quests.pre: She has never had a door she locks.
quests.scene: He gives her one, practically. She locks it. Locks it again.
quests.post: 'I am going to do that a few more times.'

quests.name: Gift-Giving Forward
quests.pre: She gives everything to everyone, always.
quests.scene: This time the giving is for her. SUBMISSIVE/DEVOTION with a player she trusts completely.
quests.post: 'Warmth.' She names it.

quests.name: Three Hundred Years of Contracts
quests.desc: The contract she is most proud of. The one she regrets. How she tells the difference.

quests.name: The Unambiguous Offer
quests.pre: Everyone is ambiguous.
quests.scene: He asks something specific. She answers specifically. Under thirty seconds. She notes the time.
quests.post: 'The first clear question I have been asked this month.'

quests.name: Her Predecessor's Mistake
quests.desc: The specific cost of unknowingly helping build the ward. What she owes. How she is paying it.

quests.name: The Clause She Did Not Include
quests.pre: She contracts everything.
quests.scene: She realises there is something she cannot put in a contract — the specific thing she wants from this interaction. She tries. The clause will not settle.
quests.post: She notarises a document about something else and spends seven seconds thinking about the unresolvable clause.

quests.name: The Verdict She Keeps Returning To
quests.desc: A case from one hundred and forty years ago she keeps re-examining. The ruling was correct. Something else is wrong.

quests.name: What Watching Gets You
quests.pre: VOYEUR — she has been watching specifically.
quests.scene: He turns and she realises he has known she was watching and has been performing for the observation. She finds this infuriating and interesting in equal measure.
quests.post: 'You noticed.' 'Yes.' 'How long?' 'From the beginning.' She revises her assessment of him upward.

quests.name: The Agreement She Cannot Write
quests.pre: She has one working draft of what this is.
quests.scene: DOMINANT lead — she runs it precisely. Mid-scene: SADIST/CONTROL, but the player does not stay in the expected position. She escalates precision. He matches. The specific thing that breaks CONTROL: he is as precise as she is.
quests.post: 'This is the closest I have been to not knowing what comes next.' She files this.

quests.name: Beyond Agreement
quests.pre: The unresolvable clause from SI-IS2.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — SADIST/VOYEUR inverted. She receives. Precisely. She finds out what lies beyond the excellent agreement.
quests.post: 'There is something beyond the contract.' She sounds genuinely surprised.

quests.name: The Notation
quests.pre: She has been making a notation in her private records.
quests.scene: She reads it to him. Eleven seconds.
quests.post: She signs it.

quests.name: The Performance That Started
quests.desc: When she began adapting to rooms. What she was before that. Whether she can still find the before.

quests.name: Not the Room
quests.pre: She adapts to every room.
quests.scene: He does not ask for the room version. He asks the question directed at her specifically — who she is when she is not performing. She gives half an answer. This is unprecedented.
quests.post: She gives half an answer. She cannot account for the half she gave.

quests.name: The Aunt She Hides From
quests.desc: What she has kept from Velura and why. That it is protection and condescension in equal measure and she cannot decide which it is.

quests.name: Seen Past the Performance
quests.pre: VOYEUR — she watches what is being watched.
quests.scene: He watches her specifically and describes what he sees: not the diplomat, not the fixer, not the succubus. The specific person.
quests.post: She does not perform for three hours. This is the longest break in seven years.

quests.name: The Four-Year Dossier
quests.desc: What it cost to keep the investigation quiet for four years. The specific day she decided not to tell Velura. Whether she would do it again.

quests.name: No Performance Layer
quests.pre: EXHIBITIONIST lean activates — but she wants to be seen truly, not performed.
quests.scene: She drops the performance entirely. SWITCH: she gives entirely herself, receives entirely. He sees all of it.
quests.post: 'That is what it feels like.'

quests.name: The Real Playfulness
quests.pre: She has been performing playfulness.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — VOYEUR as frame (he watches her be real). She discovers her actual playfulness, which is different from the performed version.
quests.post: 'I had forgotten I was actually like that.'

quests.name: Entirely Herself
quests.pre: She has been practising being entirely herself.
quests.scene: She succeeds. SERVICE/SURRENDER at depth.
quests.post: 'I am going to need to renegotiate what I do for work.'

quests.name: Velura Knows
quests.pre: She tells Velura. About the dossier, the four years. About this. This is the unlock for Velura's sub arc.
quests.scene: Velura's reaction unlocks 22a sub arc.
quests.post: She tells him: 'She cried.' Pause. 'I did not expect that.'

quests.name: What the Network Protects
quests.pre: Two centuries of protecting the house.
quests.scene: She asks what she protected it for, specifically.
quests.post: 'I am not sure anymore.' This is progress.

quests.name: The Proud Comfort
quests.pre: She does not need to prove anything.
quests.scene: DOMINANT/WORSHIP — she receives the attention the network never provided.
quests.post: 'This is what I was protecting.'

quests.name: The Seventh Generation
quests.desc: She describes one family she has watched across seven generations — what changed, what did not, what she learned about loving things that end.

quests.name: Still Here
quests.pre: Eight centuries of attrition.
quests.scene: He is still there six weeks later. He has not started an arc of decline.
quests.post: She notes: 'Still here.' She says this like an observation about the weather. It means something else.

quests.name: The Calculation She Runs
quests.desc: The specific calculation she runs before letting anything matter: time remaining, cost of loss, whether the math clears. How many times the math has cleared in eight centuries.

quests.name: The Math That Cleared
quests.pre: She ran the calculation.
quests.scene: She tells him the result. Not warmly — accurately. CONTROL lead, MASOCHIST as undercurrent — she is giving something that will cost her.
quests.post: 'The math cleared.'

quests.name: Eight Centuries of Practice
quests.pre: She has enormous patience.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — SWITCH fully active: CONTROL first, MASOCHIST second (allows something she has not allowed in two centuries), SADIST as texture. She is present in a way she has not been in a long time.
quests.post: 'I forgot I still know how to be here.'

quests.name: Worth It Anyway
quests.pre: She has been assessing: knowing the ending, is it worth it?
quests.scene: VANILLA — simply herself, fully present. She gives without the eight centuries of calculation behind the giving.
quests.post: 'Worth it.'

quests.name: The Eighth Century
quests.desc: She adds one event to her eight-century account. She does not say what she names it.

quests.name: The Mother's Faith
quests.desc: Her mother, the specific moment the mother died believing the Silence was real, what Ezan said at the grave.

quests.name: Standing There With Her
quests.pre: She has been carrying the revelation alone for twenty years.
quests.scene: He stands there with her. She describes the ritual. He does not walk away.
quests.post: 'You are still here.'

quests.name: The Priest She Left
quests.desc: The morning she walked out of the Faith. What she took, what she left, whether she misses it.

quests.name: The Search Given Company
quests.pre: She has been alone in the search.
quests.scene: He helps for one day. Then a second. Then a week. SUBMISSIVE/DEVOTION — she gives the way she gives to the search, completely.
quests.post: 'I have been waiting for someone to walk in the same direction.'

quests.name: What the Ritual Says
quests.desc: The specific part of the reconstructed ritual she has never told anyone. What it implies about where the player came from.

quests.name: Searching Together
quests.pre: She has found something.
quests.scene: SURRENDER fully active — she gives entirely, which for Ezan means giving someone the search itself. Extended intimacy as the culmination of twenty years of lonely purpose finding a partner.
quests.post: 'You can come back to this.'

quests.name: The Place She Goes Back To
quests.pre: She does not have one.
quests.scene: He gives her one. DEVOTION as the anchor.
quests.post: 'I have somewhere to go back to.'

quests.name: The Final Notes
quests.desc: She sends her full ritual notes to Syrael for safekeeping. She is not stopping — just not carrying them alone anymore.

quests.name: The Three Clans
quests.desc: How she holds Ashfang, Ironjaw, and Redhorn. The difference between authority and being followed. Which she has.

quests.name: Not a Political Alliance
quests.pre: She has filed everyone who approaches her under ALLIANCE or ENEMY.
quests.scene: He approaches without an agenda. She runs her standard classification. It does not resolve.
quests.post: She runs it again the next day. Same result.

quests.name: The Daughter She Lost
quests.desc: Five years ago. Not the specifics — the shape of it. That Garet is different from replacement. That this matters.

quests.name: The Test of Tharos
quests.pre: She runs a test on everyone who comes to the Steppe: can they see the land.
quests.scene: He sees the land. Specifically. She gives him a harder version. He passes. She has been running this test for fifteen years.
quests.post: She tells him the count of those who passed.

quests.name: What Warmothers Do Not Say
quests.desc: The one thing she says in private that she does not say in the moot. That grief and authority coexist. What it costs to hold both.

quests.name: Warmother and Woman
quests.pre: She has never had both received at once.
quests.scene: DOMINANT lead — she runs it on her terms. Midway: he addresses both — the authority and the grief beneath it. Both at once. She was not prepared for both at once.
quests.post: She is quiet for an unusual amount of time.

quests.name: All At Once
quests.pre: She has been held as only one thing at a time.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — DOMINANT/SADIST/BREEDING leans, but the frame is being chosen whole: the Warmother, the woman, the grief.
quests.post: 'I did not know I was waiting for that.'

quests.name: The Generation After
quests.pre: Everything she does is for the generation after.
quests.scene: BREEDING lean activated — she gives with that intention, specifically and privately.
quests.post: She touches her own face. 'I forgot I was still in it.'

quests.name: Chosen
quests.pre: She has been chosen for thirty years by necessity and duty.
quests.scene: He chooses her specifically — not Clan Ashfang, not the coalition, her.
quests.post: She says one word in high orc. The player does not know what it means. Garet, passing by, does. Garet says nothing.
